items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Estelle Edwards stayed with you a while? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes, she went on.

ctx.x:
And then the big break that he had was with Lawrence Elliot-- Elliot Lawrence and he sent pictures of Melvin, he was going down south, and when he sent pictures of Melvin down there, they told him they had to leave him, and so Elliot Lawrence cancelled the tour; he wouldn't go.

So then Melvin said he always
Estelle Edwards stayed with you a while?
Oh, yes, she went on. Of course Melvin was in the band a long time after that accident, because he got back straight on, way before he got with Diz.
